## External Services

### Anthropic Claude (`ext:claude`)

- Provider: Anthropic Claude
- Secrets (env): ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AI_MODEL

### MailJet (`ext:mailjet`)

- Provider: MailJet
- Secrets (env): MAILJET_API_KEY, MAILJET_SECRET_KEY

### OAuth Providers (`ext:oauth`)

- Provider: Google / Microsoft OAuth 2.0
- Secrets (env): OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, OAUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

### Payment Gateway (`ext:payment`)

- Provider: Stripe (or equivalent, via interface)
- Secrets (env): PAYMENT_SECRET_KEY, PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET

### Cloudflare R2 Storage (`ext:r2`)

- Provider: Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible)
- Secrets (env): R2_ACCESS_KEY, R2_SECRET_KEY, R2_BUCKET, R2_ENDPOINT
